subject: Control assertions & log bundle request — SIG/SOC2 scope for Redwood Hosted API
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigilfinance.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sigilfinance.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up: SIG / SOC 2 artifacts for Redwood Hosted API

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our risk review and the procurement packet, we need a few specific deliverables to move forward with a contract: a machine-readable control-assertions file (SIG or SOC2 crosswalk), a short sample of application logs for a recent week, and documentation that verifies key management and network segmentation for the Redwood Hosted API offering.

Scope: Sigil will be asking Security + Procurement to review SOC 2 controls and a SIG-lite questionnaire for the Hosted API product only (not Dedicated). Can you confirm:
- Whether you can provide a CSV mapping of Redwood controls -> SIG rows and SOC 2 criteria?
- Whether you can provide a redacted sample of API request/response logs (March 1–7, 2028) showing auth headers removed?
- A PDF network diagram and a confirmation of KMS provider + rotation cadence?

We'd like to get these artifacts by EOD Thursday (3/15) if possible to keep our procurement sprint on track. If there are any controls you cannot assert, please flag them clearly with an owner and expected remedy timeline.

Thanks —
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Security, Sigil Finance
elaine.park@sigilfinance.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigilfinance.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: SIG / SOC 2 artifacts for Redwood Hosted API

Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide a control-assertions CSV that mapsour internal controls to SIG rows and SOC 2 criteria for the Hosted API product. We can also provide a redacted sample of application logs for Mar 1–7 and a network diagram + KMS summary.

Two quick clarifying items:
1) When you say “SIG-lite,” do you have a target SIG version or template (if you can attach the SIG file we should map against it)?
2) For logs, we will remove any authentication tokens and PII; please confirm that a redacted sample is acceptable, not raw PII-bearing records.

I'll coordinate with Eng and Trust to assemble deliverables. Our working plan: control CSV + network diagram + KMS statement by EOD 3/15, logs delivered as a password-protected zip link (S3) the same day. If anything is out of scope we will call it out in the mapping file.

If helpful I can schedule a short 30-minute call Thursday morning to walk the mapping with you and Jake from CyberAudits.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigilfinance.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Moreno <jake@cyberaudits.com>, procurement@sigilfinance.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 13:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: SIG / SOC 2 artifacts for Redwood Hosted API

Thanks Tessa —

Attached is the SIG-lite template (v2027.4) — the procurement team wants the standard SIG rows plus a short narrative on compensating controls where you mark partial/missing coverage. Redacted logs are fine; we only need evidence that the controls operate in production.

Jake will be reviewing the artifacts for technical completeness; he may follow up with specific log queries. A quick call Thursday 9:00 AM PT would be useful.

Appreciate it,
Elaine

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 14:01:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: RFP follow-up: SIG / SOC 2 artifacts for Redwood Hosted API — deliverables and owners

Team — forwarding Sigil's ask (see below). Target deadline is EOD Thu 3/15. Can you help assemble the following?

Action items (owners):
- Control assertions CSV mapping (owner: Marissa) — include columns: control_id, sig_row, soc2_criterion, assertion (Yes/Partial/No), evidence_reference, remediation_eta if Partial/No.
- Sample app logs (owner: Aditya) — redacted March 1–7, include representative request/response flow; remove auth tokens/PII. Zip + password and provide S3 link.
- Network diagram + KMS statement (owner: Priyom) — PDF diagram, note KMS provider, rotation cadence, HSM or cloud KMS details.

Notes: mark any controls that are out of scope for Hosted API (we will state that Dedicated/Private are out of scope). If we need additional time on specific items, flag with estimated completion.

I'll own the final package and delivery to Sigil (EOD Thu). Deal id: DEAL-2028-0371.

Thanks —
Tessa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: RFP follow-up: SIG / SOC 2 artifacts for Redwood Hosted API — deliverables and owners

Quick update — we can deliver the following by EOD:
- app-logs-sample-20280301-20280307.zip (redacted): contains request/response traces for a sample tenant environment; all Authorization headers removed and IPs last-octet masked.
- network-diagram-redwood-hostedapi.pdf: updated diagram (edge, load balancer, VPC, subnets, peering notes).
- control-assertions-20280315.csv: draft with ~85% coverage filled; a few SOC2 rows are marked Partial with remediation notes (see "evidence_reference" column).

Notes on redaction: logs include custom user identifiers that we will hash with salt; no PII fields exported. If Sigil's assessor needs raw unredacted logs under an NDA, we can open a scoped channel — but we should avoid sharing PII.

Attachments uploaded to secure S3 path and password-protected zip as discussed. I will email the link + password to Tessa for delivery.

— Aditya
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@sigilfinance.com>
Cc: Jake Moreno <jake@cyberaudits.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverables: SIG/SOC2 mapping + sample logs (Redwood Hosted API)

Hi Elaine / Jake —

Attached are the artifacts for the Hosted API scope requested:
- control-assertions-20280315.csv (CSV mapping of Redwood controls -> SIG rows & SOC2 criteria)
- app-logs-sample-20280301-20280307.zip (password-protected; S3 link below)
- network-diagram-redwood-hostedapi.pdf

S3 link (password-protected): https://s3.redwood-internal/secure/sigil-deliverables/2028-03-15
Password: (sent via separate email for security)

A few important notes:
- The control CSV marks any out-of-scope items and provides owners and remediation ETAs for Partial/No assertions.
- Logs are redacted: auth headers removed, IP addresses masked, and user identifiers salted. If you need an unredacted set for Jake under NDA, please let us know and we can arrange a scoped transfer.
- KMS: Redwood uses AWS KMS with envelope encryption; customer data keys rotate every 90 days; HSM-backed keys are available for Dedicated/Private customers. Details are in the KMS statement in the PDF.

If helpful, I'm available 3/16 9:00–11:00 PT or we can take the 30-minute call tomorrow morning as discussed. Let me know what you'd like to review first and we can walk the control mapping with you and Jake.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
